# Subway Seat for cava

Bars rise through the 70s stripe: avocado at the floor, then harvest gold, burnt orange and redbird at the peaks. On cava without theme files, paste the `[color]` block into your config.

[cava](https://github.com/karlstav/cava) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/cava/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`themes/subway-seat`](themes/subway-seat) | ~/.config/cava/themes/subway-seat |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`themes/subway-seat-tunnel`](themes/subway-seat-tunnel) | ~/.config/cava/themes/subway-seat-tunnel |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`themes/subway-seat-enamel`](themes/subway-seat-enamel) | ~/.config/cava/themes/subway-seat-enamel |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

```ini
[color]
theme = 'subway-seat'
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

```ini
[color]
theme = 'subway-seat-tunnel'
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

```ini
[color]
theme = 'subway-seat-enamel'
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
